system.description:
You have learned to speak with the creatures of the wilds as easily as with your fellow mortals, and have continued to learn complementary techniques to augment you basic druidic training. You gain the following benefits:

  • Your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

  • You gain proficiency with the Survival skill or an expertise die if you are already proficient.

  • You gain an expertise die to your Nature skill. Your maximum expertise die size for nature increases to a d10.

  • You gain proficiency with two of your choice from the following list: alchemist’s supplies, carpenter’s tools, leatherworker's tools, or woodcarver’s tools.

  • Choose @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.z5a26lxyh3esw2rl]{Speak with Animals} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.rek0fg987gg30wp9]{Speak with Plants}. You are constantly under the effects of the chosen spell.

  • Choose a druid spell of up to 4th level with at least one rare variant. You cannot select a spell of the Summoning school for this benefit. You learn a rare variant of the selected spell for free. You only need to prepare the base version of the selected spell and can choose to cast either the rare or base variant as you see fit when casting it.
system.prerequisite: Greenlord feat, 8 levels in druid, no levels in non-druid classes at time of feat acquisition
